comparison.objective: Sort exactly five grey bolts into a kit tray and all remaining bolts into a spares tray; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Counting and repeated small-part pick-and-place versus tool insertion, counterholding, fine rotational adjustment, locking, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly five bolts must be in the white tray and all others in the black tray; candidate requires quantified stopping behavior and setting retention. No further rubric/spec is available.
comparison.reason: Bolt counting and sorting do not exercise mechanical adjustment, torque control, or dynamic response evaluation.
